subject: general
question: If ‘A + B’ means ‘A is the son of B’; ‘A - B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’, ‘A & B’ means ‘A is the father of B’ and ‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’, then what does P + R & Q - S mean?

options.text: R is the daughter of Q
P is the sister of Q
S is the brother of Q
S is the mother of P

solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/288449dd26d10f53283999d395a4806249568144fc2ce8807ef4f923639d596f.png] 

After decoding the expression P + R & Q - S we get,

P is the son of R. R is the father of Q. Q is the daughter of S.

The possible tree diagram will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ff415668946ca96c40fc368fcefab989dfa541d6e4db1d802f43b764470bf18.png] 

Hence, S is the mother of P.
